section_summary.extract_value: This Results section presents exploratory factor analysis of the SBAS-2 (State Body Appreciation Scale-2) performed separately for male and female subsamples from a single study with 244 total participants. Both subsamples yielded a single-factor solution with excellent internal consistency (α = .97 for both), and no significant differences were found between men and women on individual items or full-scale scores. Convergent and incremental validity analyses showed that state body appreciation was positively associated with life satisfaction and self-esteem, and inversely associated with BMI, with these relationships remaining significant even when controlling for general state body image.

Table 2 provides means, standard deviations, and intercorrelations for study variables across both genders.
